SMALL_FIREWORK_RUN: Step back, it goes off in 5 seconds
DIVE_TOOK_OFF: You took your diving gear off
DIVE_ERR_EMPTY: Your air tank is empty, refill it first
DIVE_ERR_GROUND: You need solid ground under your feet to put this on
SMALL_AFK_KICK: Kicked for not moving for {0} minutes
SMALL_ERR_JOB: This way is for staff only
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Small gameplay features, each with its own switch.
ADMIN_C_DRIVING_DESC: Seatbelt, cruise control, seats, radio, plates and boats.
ADMIN_H_SEATBELT: K buckles up in cars; a buckled player cannot leave the vehicle and survives faster crashes.
ADMIN_H_EJECT: A crash above this speed throws the driver through the windscreen.
ADMIN_H_CRUISE: Y holds the current speed as the vehicle's top speed until pressed again.
ADMIN_H_NO_SHUFFLE: A passenger stays in their seat when the driver gets out.
ADMIN_H_CROUCH: Left Ctrl toggles a crouched walk.
ADMIN_H_TACKLE: G while sprinting knocks down the player right in front.
ADMIN_H_BINOCULARS: Using binoculars opens a zoom camera.
ADMIN_H_FIREWORKS: Fireworks are placed on the ground and go off after 5 seconds.
ADMIN_H_AFK: Players who do not move for this long are kicked (admins never). 0 turns it off.
ADMIN_H_NO_DISPATCH: No wanted level and no AI police, ambulance or fire trucks.
ADMIN_H_HIDE_HUD: Hides GTA's cash, ammo count, area, street and vehicle names (the ai-hud shows its own).
ADMIN_TAB_TELEPORTS_DESC: Doors that take players between two points.
ADMIN_C_TELEPORT_DESC: A prompt at both ends takes the player to the other end.
KEYBIND_NEWS_VIEW: News camera view (while holding the camera)
CARRY_ERR_DECLINED: They did not want to be carried
CARRY_ERR_WAIT: Wait a moment before asking again
PLATE_ERR_KEYS: You need the keys of this vehicle
NOTE_PLACEHOLDER: Meet me at the pier at midnight.
SIT_ERR_TILT: It is tipped over too far to sit on
MOOR_TIE: Tie the boat to the dock
MOOR_TIED: The boat is tied and stays put
MOOR_UNTIED: The boat is free to go
MOOR_ERR_FAR: The boat is too far from a mooring
ADMIN_H_NO_RADIO: Vehicle radios stay off and the radio wheel does not open.
ADMIN_H_FAKE_PLATE: Fits a random plate on a vehicle the player has the keys to; using it on the vehicle again puts the real plate back. Garages keep the real plate.
ADMIN_H_BOAT_ROPE: On foot next to a boat near a mooring (Moorings tab), the player ties it so it cannot drift or be driven off, and unties it again.
ADMIN_H_POINT: B points where the camera looks; everyone sees it. Ends when the player aims, falls or fights.
ADMIN_H_SIT: Chairs, benches and stools from the Seats tab get a Sit down prompt.
ADMIN_H_CARRY: From the radial menu a player carries the nearest player over the shoulder. Downed or cuffed players are picked up at once, anyone else is asked first.
ADMIN_H_ANTI_PEEK: A player cannot shoot at what only the third person camera sees round a corner: firing stops while the gun barrel is behind cover.
ADMIN_C_ITEMS_DESC: What the small items do when used.
ADMIN_H_NOTEPAD: Using the notepad writes a page that becomes a note item; using the note shows its text.
ADMIN_H_DIVE_GEAR: Using diving_gear puts an air tank and a mask on (or takes them off); while worn the player breathes underwater until the tank is empty. diving_fill refills the tank.
ADMIN_H_DIVE_AIR: Seconds a player breathes underwater on one full tank. Air is spent only underwater and kept per character.
ADMIN_H_DIVE_FILL: Seconds refilling the tank with a diving_fill item takes.
ADMIN_C_DENSITY_DESC: How many GTA pedestrians and vehicles fill the streets. Fewer means better performance.
ADMIN_H_PED_DENSITY: Walking people, in percent of GTA's normal amount. 0 empties the streets.
ADMIN_H_SCENARIO_DENSITY: People sitting, working or standing at fixed places, in percent.
ADMIN_H_PARKED_DENSITY: Cars parked along the streets, in percent.
ADMIN_TAB_ELEVATORS_DESC: Elevators with several floors: a prompt on every floor lists the others.
ADMIN_C_ELEVATOR_DESC: Its name and floors, top to bottom or in any order you like.
ADMIN_H_FLOORS: At least two. The player arrives at the floor's point facing its heading.
ADMIN_H_FLOOR_JOB: Empty: everyone can ride to this floor.
ADMIN_TAB_MOORINGS_DESC: Dock spots boats can be tied to with the boat rope.
ADMIN_C_MOORING_DESC: A boat floating within 12 m of this spot can be tied.
ADMIN_H_MOORING_POINT: Stand at the edge of the dock where boats lie.
ADMIN_TAB_SEATS_DESC: World objects players can sit on, and where on them they sit.
ADMIN_C_SEAT_DESC: Every object of this model in the world gets a Sit down prompt.
ADMIN_H_SEAT_MODEL: The chair, bench or stool model.
ADMIN_H_SEAT_TYPE: The sitting pose the player takes.
ADMIN_H_SEAT_TELEPORT: For stools and booths the player cannot walk into; otherwise they walk to the seat.
ADMIN_H_SEATS: One row per place to sit, measured from the object's centre; heading 180 faces the object's front. The nearest free seat is taken.
ADMIN_H_HANDS_UP: X raises the hands, also in a vehicle (no fighting, aiming or getting in while they are up); X again lowers them. Other scripts ask the client export IsHandsUp.
ADMIN_H_RAGDOLL: While its key is held (set one in the Keybinds tab) on foot the player falls over and lies limp.
ADMIN_H_NO_MOUSE_STEER: Cars, bikes and boats cannot be steered with the mouse. Planes and helicopters still can.
ADMIN_H_NO_AIR_CONTROL: A car or bike in the air cannot be tilted or rolled with the keys, so a jump lands the way it took off.
ADMIN_H_NO_STEALTH: Left Ctrl no longer starts GTA's sneaking walk, so it only crouches.
ADMIN_H_SPRINT_INDOORS: Players can sprint inside buildings too, not only outside.
ADMIN_H_NO_AUTO_HELMET: Getting on a motorbike or into an aircraft does not put a helmet on by itself.
ADMIN_H_KEEP_PROPS: Hats, glasses and helmets do not fall off when the player is hit or pushed.
ADMIN_H_NO_IDLE_CAM: The camera does not start circling round a player who stands still, on foot or as a passenger.
ADMIN_H_NO_ACTION_MODE: After a punch or a shot the player walks normally again at once instead of staying in GTA's hunched combat walk.
ADMIN_H_NO_PISTOL_WHIP: With a gun in hand the melee keys do nothing, so close up the player shoots instead of hitting with the gun.
ADMIN_H_NO_COVER_PEEK: A player in cover cannot lean out to look without aiming.
ADMIN_H_NO_CRITICAL_HITS: A headshot on a player does the same damage as a body shot.
ADMIN_H_NO_BUNNY_HOP: A second jump within 5 seconds makes the player trip and fall.
ADMIN_H_NO_PICKUPS: Weapons, ammo, armour, health and money that GTA drops (from dead NPCs, for example) cannot be picked up. Items come only from the inventory.
ADMIN_H_NO_VEHICLE_REWARDS: Getting into a police car or another armed vehicle gives no weapon.
ADMIN_F_NO_EMERGENCY_SPAWNS: No GTA police and emergency vehicles
ADMIN_H_NO_EMERGENCY_SPAWNS: GTA spawns no police, ambulance, fire or army vehicles and no police, medic, guard or soldier NPCs anywhere. Vehicles and NPCs that scripts create are not affected.
ADMIN_H_EMERGENCY_AREAS: At police stations, hospitals, the prison and bases GTA parks no vehicles at all, so their car parks stay free for players.
ADMIN_H_AREA_RADIUS: Metres from the middle in every direction.
ADMIN_H_NO_AIRCRAFT: No planes take off from or park at the airports and the army base, and no jets fly over the map.
ADMIN_H_NO_POLICE_AUDIO: GTA's police scanner voice and police sounds around the city are silent.
ADMIN_H_QUIET_AMBIENCE: Mutes far away sirens, car alarms and the music GTA plays while flying.
ADMIN_H_NO_GARBAGE_TRUCKS: GTA's garbage trucks that stop in the middle of the road do not drive around.
ADMIN_TAB_DISCORD_DESC: What players' Discord profiles show while they play on this server (Rich Presence).
ADMIN_C_DISCORD_APP_DESC: Create an application at discord.com/developers (Applications > New Application). Its name is the title Discord shows above the lines, for example your server's name.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_ENABLED: Shows your application's name, pictures, text lines and buttons on every player's Discord profile. Needs the application id. Off: players keep FiveM's own presence.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_APP_ID: On discord.com/developers open your application, General Information, and copy the Application ID (17 to 20 digits). It is public, not a secret.
ADMIN_C_DISCORD_IMAGES_DESC: Upload the pictures in your application under Rich Presence > Art Assets (at least 512 x 512 px), then type their names here. A new picture can take a few minutes to show up in Discord.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_LARGE_IMAGE: The name of an Art Asset of your application: the big square picture next to the text, usually your logo. Empty: no picture.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_LARGE_TEXT: Shown when someone moves the mouse over the large picture.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_SMALL_IMAGE: The name of an Art Asset of your application: the small round picture on the corner of the large one. Empty: no small picture.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_SMALL_TEXT: Shown when someone moves the mouse over the small picture.
ADMIN_C_DISCORD_TEXT_DESC: Two lines under the application's name; Discord counts the time played next to them by itself. Placeholders: {players} players online, {maxPlayers} server slots, {name} character name, {id} server id, {job} job, {street} street the player is on. Both lines empty: FiveM's own text.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_TOP: The upper line, up to 128 characters. Updates by itself when a placeholder's value changes (the street at most every 15 seconds).
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_BOTTOM: The lower line, up to 128 characters, with the same placeholders.
ADMIN_C_DISCORD_BUTTONS_DESC: Up to two buttons under the presence that open a link, for example your Discord invite or website. Other people see and click them; Discord does not show them to the player himself.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_BUTTONS: Two at most, shown in this order.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_BUTTON_LABEL: The text on the button, up to 32 characters.
ADMIN_H_DISCORD_BUTTON_URL: The page the button opens; it must start with https://.
ADMIN_ERR_DISCORD_APP_ID: Enter the Discord application id before turning Rich Presence on.
